newsitem.title: POLAND: PPABank sets rights issue at PLN 15.5.
newsitem.headline: PPABank sets rights issue at PLN 15.5.

text.p: Polish bank Pierwszy Polsko- Amerykanski Bank SA (PPABank) has set the price of its one-for-four rights issue at 15.5 zlotys per share, the company said in an abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.
The record date for the issue of 800,000 to 1.25 million new shares is January 6.
A first subscription period is scheduled from January 13 to February 3 and a second leg from February 24 to March 10 if the first period is not fully subscribed.
PPABank closed on the Warsaw bourse's main market at 16 zlotys on Tuesday, the last session before the Christmas break. @
The bank currently has five million shares outstanding.
It said it would use most of the issue's proceeds to expand its credit activities.
